movie.title: Affection
movie.overview: Afflicted by a mysterious condition that resets her memory, Ellie becomes trapped in a cyclical nightmare with a man who claims to be her husband. She soon must uncover the horrifying truth of her existence—before she forgets it all again.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: This movie starts out feeling as though it wants to go in one direction and then pulls a lovely twist and actually makes you get invested in a completely different movie. It does this in a really good way and there is no discontinuity between the two feelings. It's very creepy and very well acted and the directing is spot on. Even the effects carry the horror of this story forward and it turns out being a lovely little horror movie. I highly recommend it.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Trapped in a relentless loop of memory loss, Ellie must uncover the terrifying truth behind the stranger claiming to be her husband before her mind resets again.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Ellie suffers from a mysterious condition that periodically wipes her memory, leaving her vulnerable and confused. Each time she wakes up, a man is there claiming to be her devoted husband, guiding her through a life she cannot recall. As subtle inconsistencies begin to surface, Ellie realizes her reality may be a carefully constructed deception. She faces a race against time to uncover the dark truth of her existence before her memory wipes clean once more.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Ellie lives in a state of perpetual disorientation, afflicted by a strange condition that routinely resets her short-term memory. Every reset forces her to rebuild her identity from scratch, relying entirely on a man who insists he is her loving husband. Although he provides comfort and safety, Ellie starts noticing unsettling flaws in his stories and terrifying anomalies in her surrounding environment. Suspicion turns into horror as she uncovers hidden clues left by past iterations of herself, warning her that she is in grave danger. Realizing her perceived life is an elaborate trap, Ellie tries to piece together the identity of her captive and the reason behind her condition. With her cognitive clock ticking down toward the next inevitable memory wipe, she must outsmart her tormentor. Every revelation brings her closer to a shocking truth about her past and the nature of her reality. Ultimately, Ellie must find a way to break the cycle or remain forever imprisoned in a nightmare of forgotten truths.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Ellie is afflicted by a mysterious neurological condition that regularly resets her memory, erasing her past and leaving her completely reliant on the present. Upon each reset, she wakes up alongside a man who claims to be her husband, offering a sense of stability in a terrifyingly blank world. However, as minor details fail to align, Ellie begins to suspect that her life is not what it seems and that her caregiver may actually be her captor. Navigating a psychological labyrinth of fear and uncertainty, she must decipher hidden messages to uncover the horrifying truth of her existence before her mind clears once again.

story_structure.climax: A critical breakthrough allows Ellie to piece together her hidden notes during a single cycle, forcing a perilous face-to-face confrontation with her keeper to regain control of her life.
story_structure.conflict: As Ellie experiences strange inconsistencies and unsettling clues around the house, she discovers that her memory resets periodically, trapping her in a cycle of dependency.
story_structure.resolution: Ellie takes decisive action to secure her freedom and break the loop, facing an uncertain future with the truth finally in her grasp.
story_structure.introduction: Ellie wakes up with no memory of her past, living in an isolated home with a man who presents himself as her devoted husband and caretaker.
story_structure.risingAction: Determined to break the cycle, Ellie begins leaving hidden clues and messages for her future self, piecing together fragments of truth while trying to evade the increasingly watchful eyes of her partner.
